skills.skill: Recognize equivalences between fractions and whole-number percents

misconceptions.pattern: Reads the fraction's numerator (or denominator) as the percent without scaling to hundredths (e.g. thinks 1/4 = 4% or 25% without checking, or 1/5 = 5%).

strategies.intent: Rewrite the fraction with denominator 100 (scale the numerator by the same factor) — that numerator is the percent; then compare.
